set.body: Goal: replace compiler-side hand enumeration of aesthetics with an internal typed aesthetic environment and scale registry while preserving the public AesSpec API. Acceptance: AesSpec can normalize to an inspectable env; scaled bindings are registered once; duplicate scaled bindings remain typed errors; PlotCompiler uses the env for row evaluation and scale metadata; existing graphics JVM/JS and graphics-svg JVM/JS tests pass.
set.title: Graphics: introduce AesEnv and ScaleRegistry
